caption: A wooden spoon is balanced across the rim of a pot and a heavy ladle set on one end, and the spoon tips and the ladle falls into the pot.

sa.check: A wooden spoon is balanced across the rim of a pot.
A ladle is set on one end of the spoon.
The ladle falls into the pot.
The ladle is set on first and the tip follows.

pc.expect: The weighted end goes down as soon as the ladle is set on it.
pc.fail: The spoon stays level with the ladle on one end; or it tips before the ladle touches it; or the empty end goes down.

pc.expect: The spoon tips off the rim and the ladle drops into the pot and stays there.
pc.fail: The ladle hangs in the air; or rises; or lands and balances on the rim.

pc.expect: The spoon pivots on the rim, the ladle slides toward the low end and falls in, and the spoon may follow.
pc.fail: The spoon slides off along the rim without tipping; or the ladle slides uphill; or the spoon flips over and lands back balanced.

pc.expect: The spoon, the ladle and the pot stay rigid and clatter.
pc.fail: The spoon bends like rubber; or the pot's rim dents; or the ladle bounces high out of the pot.

pc.expect: One spoon, one ladle and one pot keep their number.
pc.fail: The ladle vanishes or a second appears; or the spoon passes through the pot; or the pot turns into another object.

pc.expect: The spoon, the ladle and the pot stay the same.
pc.fail: The spoon changes colour; or the ladle changes size; or the pot changes between frames.
